pl.subtitle: Potwierdzenia: Dev, PM, Design, QA
pl.intro: Jedno AC = jedno kryterium akceptacji, z numerem AC1, AC2… Przy każdym AC jest przeklikanie i instrukcja „Co sprawdzić”. Gdy wszystko się zgadza, kliknij swój przycisk w Team checklist: DEV, QA, PM albo Design. Kliknięcie zapisuje Twoje imię i datę, drugie kliknięcie cofa. Uwagi wpisz w notatce albo w dyskusji przy AC, którego dotyczą, i podaj jego numer.

pl.legend: **AC** = jedno kryterium akceptacji. **Dev checklist** = analiza → poprawka → commit → test. **Co sprawdzić** = instrukcja dla PM, Design i QA. **Team checklist** = podpisy ról. **Merged** = zmiana scalona z główną gałęzią. **Diff** = kod zmian przy AC.

en.subtitle: Sign-off: Dev, PM, Design, QA
en.intro: One AC = one acceptance criterion, numbered AC1, AC2… Each AC has a click-through and “What to check” instructions. When everything matches, click your button in the Team checklist: DEV, QA, PM or Design. The click saves your name and the date; a second click undoes it. Put remarks in the note or in the discussion of the AC they are about, and mention its number.
en.indexHint: ✓ done or signed, ▶ now, ○ not yet, – not needed, ! done without proof. Click an AC to open it.
en.signDo: Click to sign with your name
en.signNeedLogin: Your account is not visible, so you cannot sign. Sign in to claude.ai.
en.threadEmpty: No messages yet. Write the first one or paste what was agreed on Slack.
en.gateNotePh: e.g. the flag decides only until an admin saves the setting
en.stepsDoneNoProof: Dev checklist: steps done, without proof:
en.roTooMany: Too many changes at once. Wait a moment.
en.roFull: The database is full. Delete old messages.
en.roOutside: Sign-offs and discussion work only in claude.ai.
en.roNoDb: State is not available in this view. Sign in to claude.ai.
en.roBroken: Connection to the database dropped. Reload the page.
en.roGeneric: State is not available in this view.
en.legend: **AC** = one acceptance criterion. **Dev checklist** = analysis → fix → commit → test. **What to check** = instructions for PM, Design and QA. **Team checklist** = each role's sign-off. **Merged** = the change is merged into the main branch. **Diff** = the code changes of an AC.

diff.empty: This AC has no code commits.
diff.loadFail: Could not load the code. Reload the page.
diff.hint: Shortcut: . opens and closes the panel, ←/→ switch AC, Esc closes.
diff.legend: + added line, − removed line. Numbers on the left are line numbers before and after.
diff.source: Preview from local branches. Source of truth: the remote repository.
diff.resize: Code panel width: drag or ←/→. Double-click resets.
